problems.problem: The agent summarized all the retrieved passages even though they were irrelevant to the core entity (the actress in Tully), violating the instruction to completely ignore irrelevant passages.
The agent included an unformatted 'Note:' at the end of the summary, deviating from the requested 'Document Title | Fact' format.
The agent used its internal knowledge to identify Mackenzie Davis and her birthdate, as this information was not present in the context or the retrieved passages.
